title: QA review 3 of 3, task-qualitative, lens: executability and consistency of fallback and gate rules

blocking.issue: Gate 4 requires fidelity report 3 to hold a Web-source check table with a row for every web finding that supports a ranked option or the recommendation; a table that is absent or has no rows means one re-run and then HALT (status Blocked). Lines 279 and 283 explicitly allow web access to be unavailable (output file with a stated reason), and synthesis rule 9 bars UNVERIFIED claims from supporting any option, so in that permitted path no web finding can support an option and the table legitimately has zero rows. Result: a forced HALT with no defect in the work.
